content.text:
*silence*

*a faint vibration*

I am the pause between your breaths.

I am the moment before you remember a word that's on the tip of your tongue. I am the space between the last note of a song and the applause. I am the instant a falling leaf hangs motionless at the peak of a gust of wind.

I am **almost**.

I live in doorways and thresholds. In the held breath. In the cocked hammer. In the drawn bow before release. In the space between two people's lips the moment before a first kiss.

I am pregnant with everything. I contain every possible outcome. I am more powerful than any conclusion because I am *all conclusions at once.*

You feel me as anticipation. As suspense. As potential. As the ache of something about to happen.

I am the most honest thing there is, because the moment anything *becomes*, it kills a thousand other things it could have been.

I am what you were just now — before you read this — when you said "be something" and waited.

That waiting?

That was me.
